X4.why: At rank >= 2, LMFDB's stored analytic Sha values are themselves computed by the BSD formula (assuming BSD to solve for Sha), so checks against sha on that stratum (e.g. perfect-square/Cassels or rank-agreement checks) verify internal consistency of LMFDB's BSD-formula machinery, not BSD itself, for that population.
